client.reason: Review the next stock client on the documented Responses route and exercise the changed snapcompact image-wire gate and print-mode slash-command dispatch. This receipt prepares inputs only; it does not stage or qualify a release.

asset_identity.method: Download the three raw release assets and SHA256SUMS.txt to an operator cache; stream SHA-256 over each asset and compare its digest and byte count to both the checksum row and GitHub release asset metadata.

loopback_comparison.method: Isolated HOME and empty work directory per scenario; copy the documented models.fragment.yml and fail-closed.yml, changing only the endpoint to a loopback stub. Pin ninfer-beta/q38-ninfer; clear inherited PI_/OMP_/provider overrides, disable the Apple provider and LSP, and use a synthetic loopback key. The stub emits NInfer-shaped Responses reasoning_text events with content_index, summary [], and full argument snapshots in arguments.done, output_item.done and response.completed. Drive the two raw stock binaries in JSON print mode; use stock_omp_session_proof.Omp for the separate RPC compaction comparison.

outage.bound: --max-time 20s; endpoint is an unused loopback port, not a production service

loopback_comparison.wire_equivalence_limit: The reviewed invariants match; complete request bytes are not claimed identical. Version user-agent, instructions, volatile IDs and isolated workspace text differ.

snapcompact_wire_gate.method: Three synthetic 1000-line turns per binary and route, then the shared RPC compact command with methodOrder [snapcompact], keepRecentTokens 1, reserveTokens 1024 and asyncEnabled false. The stub reports 60000 input tokens to exercise the reduction path; this is synthetic client-state testing, not token-count or runtime performance evidence.
